lastCompletedStory.title: Unify triage warnings source between no-op and commit paths

nextStoryContext: US-001 fixed the asymmetry in runTriage (src/commands/triage.ts): both the no-op path (changed===0) and the commit path now build ONE unified `warnings` binding (gateResult.warnings concatenated with rankIssues warnings) above the branch and pass that same binding to printTriageOutput on both sides. Added test/triage.test.ts describe block 'runTriage: unified warnings source (US-001)' with two tests (no-op run, commit run) sharing one fixture (CAM-30/31/32) that yields both a cross-stage gate warning and a missing-wsjf rank warning. Next story (US-002, RunTriageOptions.clock optional) touches the same RunTriageOptions interface in triage.ts -- read the full current file before editing, the clock field docstring at line ~68-72 already flags it as 'unused today; reserved for future timestamped commit messages', so making it optional should be a narrow interface + call-site change mirroring whatever 'unused-clock command pattern' notes says.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal refactor of runTriage's warnings plumbing plus bun:test additions; no external library API surface touched.
